actual_incident_star: If both exact-base range leverage maxima exceed 3/5, some physical row-column star of the actual N has J_ij(N)>=0.2418149394323342 a^6 and J_ij(N)/E3(N)>=0.1968816133508936.
partner_application: Using account03/B02 r29 D^2>=theta E2(N), s3(N)>=15a/16, and the rank-one-tail representation, then applying the earlier B02 incident-(3+2) transport theorem with the dominant pivot as the residual 2-minor gives ||p_Q||inf<=C_theta/a when pivot is disjoint from the heavy anchors and incident avoidance mass is >=1/4; at theta=7/64, C_theta=20.0556090985 and ||p_Q||inf<297.825706/m*.
